Rebuild: recreate these files, python3 tools/make_sfx.py (makes assets/sfx/*.wav), fonts: npm @fontsource/russo-one and @fontsource/exo-2 (latin 400/700 woff -> TTF with fontTools into assets/fonts/russo.ttf, exo400.ttf, exo700.ttf) plus assets/fonts/symbols.ttf = DejaVuSans-Bold subset of the symbols used (fontTools subset, text='★☆✓○◀▶▲▼✈◎∞■●◆'), icon.png any 256px PNG. Then: godot --headless --path . --import ; bash tools/check.sh ; godot --headless --path . -- --selftest ; bash tools/export.sh (writes ../build, splits the wasm into 3 parts, renames index.pck to index.pck.wasm, strips html/head/body from index.html). Publish all files in ../build to the same artifact URL. Web debug hashes: #title #hangar #hangar-<plane> #missions #fly-<plane>-<mission>-<cam> #touch, add ,fast for FAST graphics.

## Sky Captain - flight simulator. Game flow, cameras, input, audio, UI.

const SAVE := "user://sky_captain.cfg"
const PAINTS := [Color(0.9, 0.15, 0.15), Color(0.15, 0.4, 0.9), Color(0.95, 0.75, 0.1), Color(0.15, 0.65, 0.3), Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.18), Color(0.95, 0.45, 0.1), Color(0.6, 0.2, 0.8)]

var world: World
var plane: Aircraft
var hud: Hud
var touch: TouchUI
var cam: Camera3D
var ui: CanvasLayer
var font_t: Font
var font: Font
var font_b: Font
var state := "loading"
var screens: Dictionary = {}
var plane_id := "trainer"
var paint_i := 0
var mission: Missions
var mission_id := "free"
var cam_mode := 0
var cam_pos := Vector3.ZERO
var cam_look := Vector3.ZERO
var orbit := Vector2(0.4, 0.3)
var fast := false
var sound_on := true

var save := ConfigFile.new()

var preview_cam: Camera3D

var engine_p: AudioStreamPlayer
var wind_p: AudioStreamPlayer
var roll_p: AudioStreamPlayer
var warn_p: AudioStreamPlayer
var shot_pool: Array = []
var stall_timer := 0.0
var warn_timer := 0.0

var ring_meshes: Array = []

var smoke: Node3D

var prev_touch_throttle := -1.0
var hangar_labels: Dictionary = {}
var mission_btns: Array = []
var pause_labels: Dictionary = {}
var free_timer := 0.0
var orbit_drag := false
var paused := false

func _ready() -> void:
	font_t = load("res://assets/fonts/russo.ttf")
	font = load("res://assets/fonts/exo400.ttf")
	font_b = load("res://assets/fonts/exo700.ttf")
	var sym: Font = load("res://assets/fonts/symbols.ttf")
	font_t.fallbacks = [sym]
	font.fallbacks = [sym]
	font_b.fallbacks = [sym]
	_load_save()
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	for a in args:
		if a == "--check":
			print("CHECK OK")
			get_tree().quit()
			return
		if a == "--selftest":
			selftest = true
		if a == "--trace":
			trace = true
		if a.begins_with("--fast"):
			fast = true
	_build_ui()
	_show("loading")
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	_build_world()
	_load_sfx()
	if selftest:
		_run_selftest()
		return
	var screen := ""
	for a in args:
		if a.begins_with("--screen="):
			screen = a.substr(9)
	if screen != "":
		_debug_screen(screen)
	else:
		_show("title")

func _debug_screen(s: String) -> void:
	match s:
		"title": _show("title")
		"hangar": _show("hangar")
		"hangar-trainer", "hangar-aerobat", "hangar-viper", "hangar-liner":
			plane_id = s.substr(7)
			_refresh_preview()
			_show("hangar")
		"missions": _show("missions")
		"touch":
			touch_mode = true
			start_mission("free")
		_:
			if s.begins_with("fly-"):
				var parts := s.substr(4).split("-")
				plane_id = parts[0]
				if parts.size() > 2:
					cam_mode = int(parts[2])
				if parts.size() > 1:
					start_mission(parts[1])
				else:
					start_mission("free")
				_begin_flight()
			else:
				_show("title")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- save
func _load_save() -> void:
	if save.load(SAVE) == OK:
		plane_id = save.get_value("g", "plane", "trainer")
		paint_i = save.get_value("g", "paint", 0)
		sound_on = save.get_value("g", "sound", true)
		helper = save.get_value("g", "helper", true)
		fast = save.get_value("g", "fast", false)
		cam_mode = save.get_value("g", "cam", 0)
		stars = save.get_value("g", "stars", {})

func _save() -> void:
	save.set_value("g", "plane", plane_id)
	save.set_value("g", "paint", paint_i)
	save.set_value("g", "sound", sound_on)
	save.set_value("g", "helper", helper)
	save.set_value("g", "fast", fast)
	save.set_value("g", "cam", cam_mode)
	save.set_value("g", "stars", stars)
	save.save(SAVE)

func total_stars() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for k in stars:
		n += int(stars[k])
	return n

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- world
func _build_world() -> void:
	world = World.new()
	add_child(world)
	world.build(fast)
	plane = Aircraft.new()
	world.add_child(plane)
	plane.touchdown.connect(_on_touchdown)
	plane.crashed.connect(_on_crash)
	plane.event.connect(_on_plane_event)
	cam = Camera3D.new()
	cam.fov = 70.0
	cam.near = 0.3
	cam.far = 60000.0
	add_child(cam)
	cam.current = true
	rings_node = Node3D.new()
	world.add_child(rings_node)
	# landing dust particles
	dust = GPUParticles3D.new()
	var pm := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	pm.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	pm.spread = 60.0
	pm.initial_velocity_min = 2.0
	pm.initial_velocity_max = 6.0
	pm.gravity = Vector3(0, -1.0, 0)
	pm.scale_min = 0.5
	pm.scale_max = 1.5
	pm.color = Color(0.7, 0.65, 0.55, 0.5)
	dust.process_material = pm
	var qm := QuadMesh.new()
	qm.size = Vector2(1.5, 1.5)
	var dm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	dm.albedo_color = Color(0.75, 0.7, 0.6, 0.45)
	dm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	dm.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES
	dm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	qm.material = dm
	dust.draw_pass_1 = qm
	dust.amount = 60
	dust.lifetime = 1.2
	dust.emitting = false
	dust.one_shot = true
	dust.explosiveness = 0.8
	world.add_child(dust)
	# smoke for crashes
	smoke = Node3D.new()
	world.add_child(smoke)
	var sp := GPUParticles3D.new()
	var sm := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	sm.direction = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
	sm.spread = 40.0
	sm.initial_velocity_min = 3.0
	sm.initial_velocity_max = 9.0
	sm.gravity = Vector3(0, 1.5, 0)
	sm.scale_min = 2.0
	sm.scale_max = 5.0
	sm.color = Color(0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 0.7)
	sp.process_material = sm
	var qm2 := QuadMesh.new()
	qm2.size = Vector2(2.0, 2.0)
	var dm2 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	dm2.albedo_color = Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.42, 0.6)
	dm2.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	dm2.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES
	dm2.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	qm2.material = dm2
	sp.draw_pass_1 = qm2
	sp.amount = 80
	sp.lifetime = 3.0
	sp.emitting = false
	sp.one_shot = true
	sp.explosiveness = 0.6
	smoke.add_child(sp)
	# hangar preview plane (rotating) above the terminal
	preview = Node3D.new()
	world.add_child(preview)
	preview.position = Vector3(0, World.AIRPORT_ALT + 1.6, 230.0)
	preview_cam = Camera3D.new()
	preview_cam.fov = 45.0
	preview_cam.far = 60000.0
	add_child(preview_cam)
	_refresh_preview()

func _refresh_preview() -> void:
	for c in preview.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var m := Planes.build(plane_id, PAINTS[paint_i])
	preview.add_child(m)
	var s := Planes.by_id(plane_id)
	preview.position.y = World.AIRPORT_ALT - s.gear.l.y
	preview_cam.position = preview.position + Vector3(-s.cam * 0.9, s.cam * 0.32, -s.cam * 0.55)
	preview_cam.look_at(preview.position + Vector3(0, s.len * 0.03, 0))
	preview_cam.h_offset = -s.cam * 0.3

func _load_sfx() -> void:
	for nm in ["piston", "jet", "wind", "roll", "stall", "warn", "touch", "gear", "flaps", "click", "ding", "win", "fail", "crash", "ring", "shutter"]:
		var w: AudioStreamWAV = load("res://assets/sfx/%s.wav" % nm)
		if w and nm in ["piston", "jet", "wind", "roll"]:
			w.loop_mode = AudioStreamWAV.LOOP_FORWARD
			w.loop_end = w.data.size() / 2
		sfx[nm] = w
	engine_p = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	add_child(engine_p)
	wind_p = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	wind_p.stream = sfx["wind"]
	add_child(wind_p)
	roll_p = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	roll_p.stream = sfx["roll"]
	add_child(roll_p)
	warn_p = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	add_child(warn_p)
	for i in range(6):
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		add_child(p)
		shot_pool.append(p)

func play(nm: String, vol_db: float = 0.0, pitch: float = 1.0) -> void:
	if not sound_on or not sfx.has(nm):
		return
	for p in shot_pool:
		if not p.playing:
			p.stream = sfx[nm]
			p.volume_db = vol_db
			p.pitch_scale = pitch
			p.play()
			return

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI
func _style(col: Color, border: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25)) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = col
	sb.border_color = border
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(8)
	return sb

func _button(txt: String, size: Vector2, col: Color = Color(0.12, 0.3, 0.6), fs: int = 20) -> Button:

	b.custom_minimum_size = size
	b.add_theme_font_override("font", font_t)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _style(col))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _style(col.lightened(0.15)))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _style(col.darkened(0.2), Color(1, 0.9, 0.4)))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _style(col))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	b.pressed.connect(func(): play("click", -6.0))
	return b

func _label(txt: String, fs: int = 18, f: Font = null, col: Color = Color(1, 1, 1)) -> Label:

	l.add_theme_font_override("font", f if f else font)
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	l.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 1)
	l.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 2)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	return l

		_fmt_int(int(s.mass)), s.span, s.len, s.cruise, s.Vne, s.Vr, eng, ", ".join(s.flap_names), "retractable" if s.retract else "fixed"]

func _fmt_int(n: int) -> String:
	var s := str(n)
	var out := ""
	var c := 0
	for i in range(s.length() - 1, -1, -1):
		out = s[i] + out
		c += 1
		if c % 3 == 0 and i > 0:
			out = "," + out
	return out

func _begin_flight() -> void:
	var m := Missions.by_id(mission_id)
	var s := Planes.by_id(plane_id)
	plane.setup(s, world, PAINTS[paint_i])
	plane.helper = helper
	plane.visible = true
	var start: String = m.start
	match start:
		"runway":
			var x := -World.RUNWAY_LEN * 0.5 + 60.0
			if mission_id == "airline":
				x = -World.RUNWAY_LEN * 0.5 + 40.0
			plane.place(Vector3(x, World.AIRPORT_ALT + plane.gear_h() + 0.05, 0.0), 90.0, 0.0)
		"final":
			var v: float = s.Vapp * Planes.KT * 1.1
			plane.place(Vector3(-7000.0, World.AIRPORT_ALT + 1250.0 * Planes.FT, 0.0), 90.0, v)
			plane.flap_idx = s.flaps.size() - 1 if s.id != "liner" else 3
			plane.flap_pos = plane.flap_deg()
			plane.gear_target = 1.0
			plane.gear_pos = 1.0
			plane.throttle = 0.45 if s.kind == "prop" else 0.5
		"air":
			var v2: float = s.cruise * Planes.KT
			plane.place(Vector3(-1000.0, World.AIRPORT_ALT + 3500.0 * Planes.FT, 1500.0), 90.0, v2)
			plane.throttle = 0.9
	plane.rpm = s.idle_rpm if s.kind == "prop" else 22.0
	kb_throttle = plane.throttle
	touch.throttle = plane.throttle
	mission = Missions.new()
	mission.start(m, plane, world)
	_build_rings()
	result_shown = false
	crash_reason = ""
	stall_timer = 0.0
	free_timer = 0.0
	msg_label.text = ""
	cam.current = true
	preview_cam.current = false
	touch.show_flaps = s.flaps.size() > 1
	touch.show_gear = s.retract
	touch.show_spoiler = s.brakeCD > 0.0
	touch.show_ab = s.ab
	touch.show_rev = s.reverse
	touch.layout()
	touch.visible = touch_mode or DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available()
	_show("fly")
	_update_camera(0.0, true)
	if engine_p:
		engine_p.stream = sfx["piston"] if s.kind == "prop" else sfx["jet"]
		if sound_on:
			engine_p.play()
			wind_p.play()
			roll_p.play()
	_message("Fly!" if start != "runway" else "Ready for take-off on runway 09", 3.0)

func _keep_flying() -> void:
	# continue in free flight from where the plane is (after a mission result)
	mission_id = "free"
	mission = Missions.new()
	mission.start(Missions.by_id("free"), plane, world)
	_build_rings()
	result_shown = false
	_show("fly")
	cam.current = true
	preview_cam.current = false
	if plane.alive == false:
		start_mission("free")
		_begin_flight()

func _build_rings() -> void:
	for c in rings_node.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	ring_meshes.clear()
	if mission == null or mission.gates.is_empty():
		return
	var tm := TorusMesh.new()
	tm.inner_radius = mission.gate_r * 0.85
	tm.outer_radius = mission.gate_r
	tm.rings = 24
	tm.ring_segments = 12
	var i := 0
	for g in mission.gates:
		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
		mi.mesh = tm
		mi.material_override = Geo.mat(Color(1, 0.8, 0.2), 0.4, 0.2, Color(1, 0.6, 0.1))
		mi.position = g
		# face the next gate
		var nxt: Vector3 = mission.gates[mini(i + 1, mission.gates.size() - 1)] if i + 1 < mission.gates.size() else g + (g - mission.gates[max(i - 1, 0)])
		var prev: Vector3 = mission.gates[max(i - 1, 0)]
		var dir := (nxt - prev)
		dir.y = 0.0
		if dir.length() > 1.0:
			mi.look_at_from_position(g, g + dir, Vector3.UP)
		rings_node.add_child(mi)
		ring_meshes.append(mi)
		i += 1

func _on_touchdown(vs: float, hard: bool) -> void:
	if plane.dist_flown < 30.0:
		return
	play("touch", 0.0 if hard else -8.0, 1.0 if hard else 1.2)
	dust.global_position = plane.global_position + Vector3(0, -plane.gear_h() + 0.5, 0)
	dust.restart()
	dust.emitting = true
	if mission:
		mission.on_touchdown(vs)
	var fpm := int(vs / Planes.FT * 60.0)
	if hard:
		_message("HARD landing: %d ft/min" % fpm, 2.5)
	elif vs < 1.0:
		_message("Butter! %d ft/min" % fpm, 2.5)

	var sp: GPUParticles3D = smoke.get_child(0)

	sp.restart()
	sp.emitting = true
	plane.visible = false

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if e is InputEventKey and e.pressed and not e.echo:
		var k: InputEventKey = e
		if state == "fly":
			match k.keycode:
				KEY_G: _do_action("gear")
				KEY_F: _do_action("flapdn")
				KEY_V: _do_action("flapup")
				KEY_SPACE: _do_action("spoiler")
				KEY_X: _do_action("ab")
				KEY_R: _do_action("rev")
				KEY_1: _do_action("trimdn")
				KEY_2: _do_action("trimup")
				KEY_P: _do_action("park")
				KEY_C: _do_action("cam")
				KEY_ESCAPE: _pause()
				KEY_H:
					helper = not helper
					plane.helper = helper
					_message("HELPER " + ("ON" if helper else "OFF"), 1.5)
		elif state == "pause" and k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			_resume()
		elif state == "result" and k.keycode == KEY_ENTER:
			start_mission(mission_id)
	if state == "fly" and cam_mode == 2:
		if e is InputEventMouseButton:
			var mb: InputEventMouseButton = e
			if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
				orbit_drag = mb.pressed
		if e is InputEventMouseMotion and orbit_drag:
			var mm: InputEventMouseMotion = e
			orbit.x -= mm.relative.x * 0.005
			orbit.y = clamp(orbit.y - mm.relative.y * 0.005, -0.4, 1.2)

func _read_inputs(dt: float) -> void:
	var pitch := 0.0
	var roll := 0.0
	var yaw := 0.0
	var brake := 0.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W):
		pitch -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S):
		pitch += 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A):
		roll -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D):
		roll += 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_Q):
		yaw -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_E):
		yaw += 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_B):
		brake = 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_EQUAL) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_KP_ADD):
		kb_throttle = clamp(kb_throttle + dt * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
		touch.throttle = kb_throttle
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_CTRL) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_MINUS) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_KP_SUBTRACT):
		kb_throttle = clamp(kb_throttle - dt * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
		touch.throttle = kb_throttle
	# gamepad
	if Input.get_connected_joypads().size() > 0:
		var lx := Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X)
		var ly := Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y)
		var rx := Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X)
		if abs(lx) > 0.1:
			roll += lx
		if abs(ly) > 0.1:
			pitch += ly
		if abs(rx) > 0.1:
			yaw += rx
		var tr := Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT)
		var tl := Input.get_joy_axis(0, JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_LEFT)
		if tr > 0.05:
			kb_throttle = clamp(kb_throttle + tr * dt * 0.8, 0.0, 1.0)
			touch.throttle = kb_throttle
		if tl > 0.05:
			kb_throttle = clamp(kb_throttle - tl * dt * 0.8, 0.0, 1.0)
			touch.throttle = kb_throttle
	# touch
	if touch.visible:
		pitch += touch.stick.y
		roll += touch.stick.x
		yaw += touch.rudder
		if touch.brake_held:
			brake = 1.0
	if touch.throttle != kb_throttle:
		kb_throttle = touch.throttle
	plane.in_pitch = clamp(pitch, -1.0, 1.0)
	plane.in_roll = clamp(roll, -1.0, 1.0)
	plane.in_yaw = clamp(yaw, -1.0, 1.0)
	plane.brake = brake
	plane.throttle = kb_throttle

		# releasing park brake when throttling up is what a real checklist does, but we only hint
		pass

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- loop
func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	t += dt
	if world:
		world.tick(dt, t, wind)
	if state == "fly" and plane and plane.alive:
		_read_inputs(dt)
		plane.step(dt)
		if mission:
			mission.tick(dt)
			mission.check_stopped()
			if (mission.done or mission.failed) and not result_shown:
				_show_result()
		_update_camera(dt, false)
		_update_hud(dt)
		_update_audio(dt)
		world.update_papi(plane.global_position)
		for i in range(ring_meshes.size()):
			var mi: MeshInstance3D = ring_meshes[i]
			var m: StandardMaterial3D = mi.material_override
			if i < mission.gate_i:
				mi.visible = false
			elif i == mission.gate_i:
				mi.visible = true
				m.albedo_color = Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.4)
				m.emission = Color(0.2, 1.0, 0.3)
				mi.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.0 + 0.05 * sin(t * 6.0))
			else:
				mi.visible = i < mission.gate_i + 3
				m.albedo_color = Color(1, 0.8, 0.2)
				m.emission = Color(1, 0.6, 0.1)
	elif state in ["title", "hangar", "missions", "brief"]:
		preview.rotation.y += dt * 0.35
	elif state in ["result", "pause"]:
		_update_camera(dt, false)
		if plane and plane.alive and state == "result":
			_read_inputs(dt)
			plane.step(dt)
	if msg_t > 0.0:
		msg_t -= dt
		if msg_t <= 0.0:
			msg_label.text = ""

func _update_camera(dt: float, snap: bool) -> void:
	var xf := plane.global_transform
	var s := plane.spec
	var fwd := -xf.basis.z
	var up := xf.basis.y
	var target_pos: Vector3
	var target_look: Vector3
	var cam_up := Vector3.UP
	match cam_mode:
		0:
			var d: float = s.cam
			var fwd_flat := fwd
			target_pos = xf.origin - fwd * d + Vector3.UP * d * 0.28 + up * d * 0.05
			target_look = xf.origin + fwd * d * 0.6
			cam_up = Vector3.UP.lerp(up, 0.35).normalized()
		1:
			target_pos = xf * s.eye
			target_look = target_pos + fwd * 100.0
			cam_up = up
			snap = true
		2:
			var d2: float = s.cam * 1.1
			var dir := Vector3(cos(orbit.y) * sin(orbit.x), sin(orbit.y), cos(orbit.y) * cos(orbit.x))
			target_pos = xf.origin + dir * d2
			target_look = xf.origin
		3:
			target_pos = Vector3(380.0, World.AIRPORT_ALT + 46.0, 350.0)
			if plane.global_position.distance_to(target_pos) > 2500.0:
				target_pos = plane.global_position + Vector3(0, 300.0, 0) + (plane.global_position - target_pos).normalized() * -800.0
				target_pos.y = max(target_pos.y, world.height(target_pos.x, target_pos.z) + 50.0)
			target_look = xf.origin
			snap = true
	# keep the camera above the ground
	var gh := world.height(target_pos.x, target_pos.z)
	if target_pos.y < gh + 1.5 and cam_mode != 1:
		target_pos.y = gh + 1.5
	if snap or cam_mode == 1:
		cam_pos = target_pos
		cam_look = target_look
	else:
		var k: float = min(1.0, dt * 6.0)
		cam_pos = cam_pos.lerp(target_pos, k)
		cam_look = cam_look.lerp(target_look, min(1.0, dt * 10.0))
	cam.global_position = cam_pos
	if plane.model:
		plane.model.visible = cam_mode != 1 and plane.alive
	if cam_look.distance_to(cam_pos) > 0.1:
		cam.look_at(cam_look, cam_up)
	cam.fov = 70.0 if cam_mode != 1 else 80.0
	if cam_mode == 3:
		var d3 := cam_pos.distance_to(xf.origin)
		cam.fov = clamp(1200.0 / max(d3, 20.0) * 2.0, 4.0, 60.0)

func _update_hud(dt: float) -> void:
	hud.plane = plane
	hud.checklist = mission.checklist if mission else []
	hud.nav_bearing = mission.nav_bearing if mission else -1.0
	hud.nav_dist = mission.nav_dist if mission else 0.0
	hud.nav_text = mission.wp_name if mission else ""
	var m := Missions.by_id(mission_id)
	hud.mission_line = m.short if mission_id != "free" else ""
	if mission and mission.timing:
		hud.time_line = "%d:%02d.%d" % [int(mission.timer) / 60, int(mission.timer) % 60, int(fmod(mission.timer, 1.0) * 10.0)]
	elif mission_id == "free":
		free_timer += dt
		hud.time_line = ""
	else:
		hud.time_line = ""
	# warnings (priority)
	var w := ""
	var s := plane.spec
	var agl := plane.agl_m()
	if plane.stall:
		w = "STALL"
	elif plane.overspeed:
		w = "OVERSPEED"
	elif s.retract and plane.gear_pos < 0.5 and agl < 150.0 and plane.vs < -1.0 and plane.throttle < 0.5:
		w = "GEAR UP!"
	elif agl < 120.0 and plane.vs < -7.0:
		w = "SINK RATE - PULL UP"
	elif plane.fuel <= 0.0:
		w = "OUT OF FUEL"
	elif s.flaps.size() > 1 and plane.flap_pos > 0.5 and plane.airspeed > s.Vfe * Planes.KT:
		w = "FLAPS TOO FAST"
	hud.warn_text = w

func _update_audio(dt: float) -> void:
	if not sound_on:
		return
	var s := plane.spec
	if s.kind == "prop":
		engine_p.pitch_scale = clamp(0.35 + plane.rpm / s.max_rpm * 1.0, 0.3, 1.5)
		engine_p.volume_db = lerp(-18.0, -2.0, plane.rpm / s.max_rpm)
	else:
		engine_p.pitch_scale = clamp(0.6 + plane.rpm / 100.0 * 0.8, 0.5, 1.6)
		engine_p.volume_db = lerp(-16.0, -1.0, plane.rpm / 100.0) + (4.0 if plane.ab and plane.throttle > 0.9 else 0.0)
	if cam_mode == 1:
		engine_p.volume_db -= 4.0
	var ws: float = clamp(plane.airspeed / (s.Vne * Planes.KT), 0.0, 1.0)
	wind_p.volume_db = lerp(-40.0, -6.0, ws)
	wind_p.pitch_scale = 0.7 + ws * 0.7
	if plane.on_ground and plane.airspeed > 1.0:
		roll_p.volume_db = lerp(-30.0, -8.0, clamp(plane.airspeed / 40.0, 0.0, 1.0))
	else:
		roll_p.volume_db = -60.0
	# stall horn / warnings
	var w := hud.warn_text
	if w == "STALL":
		stall_timer -= dt
		if stall_timer <= 0.0:
			warn_p.stream = sfx["stall"]
			warn_p.volume_db = -4.0
			warn_p.play()
			stall_timer = 0.6
	elif w != "":
		stall_timer -= dt
		if stall_timer <= 0.0:
			warn_p.stream = sfx["warn"]
			warn_p.volume_db = -6.0
			warn_p.play()
			stall_timer = 0.9
	else:
		stall_timer = 0.0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- self test (headless bot)
func _run_selftest() -> void:
	var fails := 0
	var report: Array = []
	for pid in ["trainer", "aerobat", "viper", "liner"]:
		var r := _bot_takeoff(pid)
		report.append(r)
		if not r.begins_with("PASS"):
			fails += 1
	var l := _bot_landing("trainer")
	report.append(l)
	if not l.begins_with("PASS"):
		fails += 1
	var l2 := _bot_landing("liner")
	report.append(l2)
	if not l2.begins_with("PASS"):
		fails += 1
	var ro := _bot_roll("aerobat")
	report.append(ro)
	if not ro.begins_with("PASS"):
		fails += 1
	var cr := _bot_crash("trainer")
	report.append(cr)
	if not cr.begins_with("PASS"):
		fails += 1
	var st := _bot_stall("trainer")
	report.append(st)
	if not st.begins_with("PASS"):
		fails += 1
	for line in report:
		print(line)
	print("SELFTEST " + ("PASS" if fails == 0 else "FAIL (%d)" % fails))
	get_tree().quit(0 if fails == 0 else 1)

func _bot_setup(pid: String, mid: String) -> void:
	plane_id = pid
	mission_id = mid
	touch_mode = false
	_begin_flight()
	sound_on = false

func _bot_takeoff(pid: String) -> String:
	_bot_setup(pid, "takeoff")
	var s := plane.spec
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	plane.set_flaps(mission.to_flap_idx())
	plane.park = false
	plane.throttle = 1.0
	var maxalt := 0.0
	var lifted_x := 0.0
	var t2 := 0.0
	var stalls := 0
	while t2 < 180.0 and plane.alive and not mission.done:
		var vr: float = s.Vr * Planes.KT
		plane.in_pitch = 0.0
		if plane.on_ground:
			if plane.airspeed > vr:
				plane.in_pitch = 0.4
		else:
			# climb at about 1.35 x Vr, nose between 3 and 15 degrees
			var vt: float = vr * 1.35
			var want_pitch: float = clamp(8.0 + (plane.airspeed - vt) * 0.6, 3.0, 15.0)
			plane.in_pitch = clamp((want_pitch - plane.pitch_deg()) * 0.06 - plane.omega.x * 0.5, -0.4, 0.5)
		if not plane.on_ground and plane.air_time > 2.0 and s.retract:
			if plane.gear_pos > 0.9 and plane.gear_target > 0.5:
				plane.toggle_gear()
		if not plane.on_ground and plane.airspeed > s.Vr * Planes.KT * 1.3:
			plane.set_flaps(0)
		if not plane.on_ground and plane.air_time > 0.3 and lifted_x == 0.0:
			lifted_x = plane.global_position.x
		plane.in_roll = clamp(-plane.bank_deg() * 0.05, -0.5, 0.5)
		plane.step(dt)
		mission.tick(dt)
		_trace(dt, "TO")
		if plane.stall:
			stalls += 1
		maxalt = max(maxalt, plane.global_position.y - World.AIRPORT_ALT)
		t2 += dt
	var roll_m := lifted_x + World.RUNWAY_LEN * 0.5 - 60.0
	var ok := plane.alive and mission.done
	return "%s takeoff %s: airborne after %d m, max alt %d ft, stars %d, %.0fs, stall ticks %d%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", pid, int(roll_m), int(maxalt / Planes.FT), mission.stars, t2, stalls, "" if plane.alive else " CRASH " + crash_reason]

func _bot_landing(pid: String) -> String:
	_bot_setup(pid, "landing")
	var s := plane.spec
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	var vapp: float = s.Vapp * Planes.KT
	var t2 := 0.0
	var touched := false
	var tvs := 0.0
	var stop_x := 0.0
	var thr := plane.throttle
	var pitch_cmd := 0.0
	while t2 < 300.0 and plane.alive and not mission.done:
		var agl := plane.agl_m()
		# glide slope target: 3 degrees to the aim point 300 m past threshold
		var aim_x := -World.RUNWAY_LEN * 0.5 + 300.0
		var dx := aim_x - plane.global_position.x
		var target_alt: float = World.AIRPORT_ALT + max(dx, 0.0) * tan(deg_to_rad(3.0))
		var alt_err := target_alt - plane.global_position.y
		var want_vs: float = clamp(alt_err * 0.3, -4.0, 2.0) - (plane.airspeed * sin(deg_to_rad(3.0)) if dx > 0.0 else 0.0)
		if not plane.on_ground:
			if agl < plane.airspeed * 0.3 and dx < 260.0:
				# flare: hold a gentle sink
				want_vs = lerp(-0.5, -2.5, clamp(agl / (plane.airspeed * 0.3), 0.0, 1.0))
				thr = move_toward(thr, 0.0, dt * 0.4)
			else:
				var spd_err := vapp - plane.airspeed
				thr = clamp(thr + spd_err * 0.02 * dt * 6.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			var kg: float = 50.0 / s.Vref
			pitch_cmd = clamp(pitch_cmd + (want_vs - plane.vs) * 0.004 * kg - plane.omega.x * 0.03 / kg, -0.6, 0.7)
			plane.in_pitch = pitch_cmd
			plane.in_roll = clamp((-plane.global_position.z * 0.01 - plane.vel.z * 0.15) - plane.bank_deg() * 0.03, -0.3, 0.3)
			plane.in_yaw = 0.0
		else:
			thr = 0.0
			plane.in_pitch = 0.0
			plane.brake = 1.0
			plane.in_roll = 0.0
			plane.in_yaw = clamp(-plane.global_position.z * 0.02 - plane.vel.z * 0.1, -0.5, 0.5)
			if s.id == "liner":
				plane.reverse = plane.airspeed > 30.0
				plane.airbrake = true
		plane.throttle = thr
		if not touched and plane.on_ground:
			touched = true
			tvs = plane.touch_vs
		plane.step(dt)
		mission.tick(dt)
		mission.check_stopped()
		_trace(dt, "LD")
		t2 += dt
	stop_x = plane.global_position.x
	var ok := plane.alive and mission.done
	return "%s landing %s: touchdown %d ft/min at x=%d z=%.1f, stopped x=%d, stars %d, %.0fs%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", pid, int(tvs / Planes.FT * 60.0), int(mission.touch_pos.x), mission.touch_pos.z, int(stop_x), mission.stars, t2, "" if plane.alive else " CRASH " + crash_reason]

func _bot_roll(pid: String) -> String:
	_bot_setup(pid, "aero")
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	var t2 := 0.0
	var start_bank := plane.total_roll
	plane.throttle = 1.0
	plane.in_roll = 1.0
	while t2 < 1.2:
		plane.step(dt)
		t2 += dt
	var rolled := plane.total_roll - start_bank
	var ok: bool = plane.alive and abs(rolled) > 200.0
	var start_alt := plane.global_position.y
	# loop
	plane.in_roll = 0.0
	plane.in_pitch = 0.0
	var tl := 0.0
	while tl < 4.0:
		plane.in_roll = clamp(-plane.bank_deg() * 0.05, -1.0, 1.0)
		plane.step(dt)
		tl += dt
	plane.in_roll = 0.0
	plane.in_pitch = 0.75
	var t3 := 0.0
	var p0 := plane.total_pitch
	while t3 < 16.0 and plane.alive and plane.total_pitch - p0 < 350.0:
		plane.step(dt)
		_trace(dt, "LP")
		t3 += dt
	var looped := plane.total_pitch - p0
	ok = ok and looped >= 300.0 and plane.alive
	return "%s aerobat: rolled %d deg in 1.2 s, looped %d deg in %.1f s, maxG %.1f" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", int(rolled), int(looped), t3, plane.max_g]

func _bot_crash(pid: String) -> String:
	_bot_setup(pid, "landing")
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	var t2 := 0.0
	plane.in_pitch = -1.0
	plane.throttle = 1.0
	while t2 < 60.0 and plane.alive:
		plane.step(dt)
		t2 += dt
	return "%s crash test: %s after %.0fs" % ["PASS" if not plane.alive else "FAIL", crash_reason, t2]

func _bot_stall(pid: String) -> String:
	_bot_setup(pid, "aero")
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	var t2 := 0.0
	plane.throttle = 0.0
	plane.in_pitch = 0.8
	var stalled := false
	var min_spd := 999.0
	var t_stall := -1.0
	var recovered := false
	var alt_at_stall := 0.0
	while t2 < 60.0 and plane.alive:
		plane.step(dt)
		_trace(dt, "ST")
		if plane.stall and not stalled:
			stalled = true
			t_stall = t2
			alt_at_stall = plane.global_position.y
		if stalled:
			plane.in_pitch = 0.0 if plane.airspeed < 35.0 else clamp(-plane.pitch_deg() / 40.0, -0.2, 0.6)
			plane.throttle = 1.0
			plane.in_roll = clamp(-plane.bank_deg() * 0.03, -0.5, 0.5)
			if t2 - t_stall > 2.0 and plane.airspeed > 45.0 and plane.vs > -3.0 and not plane.stall:
				recovered = true
				break
		min_spd = min(min_spd, plane.airspeed)
		t2 += dt
	return "%s stall test: stalled=%s min speed %d kt, recovered=%s after %.1f s, alt lost %d ft" % ["PASS" if stalled and recovered else "FAIL", stalled, int(min_spd / Planes.KT), recovered, t2 - t_stall, int((alt_at_stall - plane.global_position.y) / Planes.FT)]

func _trace(dt: float, tag: String) -> void:
	if not trace:
		return
	trace_t += dt
	if trace_t >= 1.0:
		trace_t = 0.0
		var p := plane
		print("%s x=%d z=%d alt=%dft agl=%dm kt=%d vs=%.1f pit=%.1f bank=%.1f a=%.2f in=%.2f thr=%.2f g=%.1f st=%s gnd=%s w=%d rpm=%d fl=%d gear=%.1f" % [tag, int(p.global_position.x), int(p.global_position.z), int(p.altitude_ft()), int(p.agl_m()), int(p.airspeed / Planes.KT), p.vs, p.pitch_deg(), p.bank_deg(), p.alpha, p.in_pitch, p.throttle, p.gforce, p.stall, p.on_ground, p.wheels_down, int(p.rpm), int(p.flap_pos), p.gear_pos])

static func by_id(id: String) -> Dictionary:
	for s in specs():
		if s.id == id:

	return specs()[0]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- models

static func build(id: String, paint: Color) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Model"
	match id:
		"trainer": _trainer(root, paint)
		"aerobat": _aerobat(root, paint)
		"viper": _viper(root, paint)
		"liner": _liner(root, paint)
	return root

static func _gearnode(parent: Node3D, nm: String, pivot: Vector3) -> Node3D:
	var g := Node3D.new()
	g.name = nm
	g.position = pivot
	parent.add_child(g)
	return g

static func _strut(g: Node3D, len: float, r: float, m: Material) -> void:
	Geo.cyl(g, r, len, m, Vector3(0, -len * 0.5, 0))

static func _surface(parent: Node3D, nm: String, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, m: Material, hinge_sign: float = 1.0) -> Node3D:
	# control surface hinged at its front edge (node origin), extends backward (+z)
	var n := Node3D.new()
	n.name = nm
	n.position = pos
	parent.add_child(n)
	Geo.box(n, size, m, Vector3(0, 0, size.z * 0.5 * hinge_sign))
	return n

static func _prop(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3, r: float, blades: int, m: Material) -> Node3D:
	var p := Node3D.new()
	p.name = "Prop"
	p.position = pos
	parent.add_child(p)
	for i in range(blades):
		var blade := Node3D.new()
		blade.rotation_degrees = Vector3(0, 0, 360.0 * float(i) / float(blades))
		p.add_child(blade)
		Geo.box(blade, Vector3(0.09, r, 0.035), m, Vector3(0, r * 0.5, 0), Vector3(0, 25, 0))
	# spinner
	Geo.cyl(p, 0.16, 0.35, m, Vector3(0, 0, -0.15), Vector3(90, 0, 0), 0.05)
	# blurred disc shown when spinning
	var disc := CylinderMesh.new()
	disc.top_radius = r
	disc.bottom_radius = r
	disc.height = 0.02
	var dm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	dm.albedo_color = Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.22, 0.28)
	dm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	dm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	var d := Geo.inst(parent, disc, dm, pos, Vector3(90, 0, 0), Vector3.ONE, "PropDisc")
	d.visible = false
	return p

static func _pilot(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3, scale: float = 1.0) -> void:
	var skin := Geo.mat(Color(0.85, 0.65, 0.5))
	Geo.sphere(parent, 0.14 * scale, skin, pos + Vector3(0, 0.36 * scale, 0))
	Geo.box(parent, Vector3(0.3, 0.1, 0.32) * scale, Geo.mat(Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)), pos + Vector3(0, 0.44 * scale, 0))

class_name TouchUI
extends Control
## On-screen controls for iPad: stick, rudder slider, throttle slider, buttons.

signal pressed(name: String)

var stick := Vector2.ZERO        # x roll, y pitch (+1 = pull back)
var rudder := 0.0
var throttle := 0.0
var brake_held := false
var font: Font
var buttons: Array = []           # [name, label, rect, held]
var stick_c := Vector2.ZERO
var stick_r := 70.0
var stick_id := -1
var rud_id := -1
var thr_id := -1
var thr_rect := Rect2()
var rud_rect := Rect2()
var btn_ids: Dictionary = {}      # touch index -> button name
var active := true
var show_ab := false
var show_rev := false
var show_flaps := true
var show_gear := true
var show_spoiler := true
var pressed_vis: Dictionary = {}

func _ready() -> void:
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP

func layout() -> void:
	var sz := get_viewport_rect().size
	var compact := sz.x < 900.0
	stick_r = 60.0 if compact else 74.0
	stick_c = Vector2(stick_r + 40.0, sz.y - stick_r - 40.0)
	rud_rect = Rect2(stick_c.x - stick_r - 10.0, stick_c.y - stick_r - 60.0, stick_r * 2.0 + 20.0, 36.0)
	var tw := 54.0
	var th := 230.0 if not compact else 170.0
	thr_rect = Rect2(sz.x - tw - 28.0, sz.y - th - 40.0, tw, th)
	buttons.clear()
	var bw := 92.0 if not compact else 72.0
	var bh := 40.0 if not compact else 34.0
	var bx := thr_rect.position.x - bw - 16.0
	var by := sz.y - 40.0 - bh
	var col: Array = []
	col.append(["brake", "BRAKE"])
	col.append(["park", "PARK"])
	if show_gear:
		col.append(["gear", "GEAR"])
	if show_flaps:
		col.append(["flapdn", "FLAPS +"])
		col.append(["flapup", "FLAPS -"])
	if show_spoiler:
		col.append(["spoiler", "AIRBRK"])
	if show_ab:
		col.append(["ab", "AB"])
	if show_rev:
		col.append(["rev", "REVERSE"])
	var k := 0
	for b in col:
		buttons.append([b[0], b[1], Rect2(bx, by - float(k) * (bh + 8.0), bw, bh), false])
		k += 1
	# trim + camera on a second column
	var bx2 := bx - bw - 12.0
	buttons.append(["trimup", "TRIM ▲", Rect2(bx2, by, bw, bh), false])
	buttons.append(["trimdn", "TRIM ▼", Rect2(bx2, by - (bh + 8.0), bw, bh), false])
	buttons.append(["cam", "CAMERA", Rect2(bx2, by - 2.0 * (bh + 8.0), bw, bh), false])
	buttons.append(["pause", "II", Rect2(sz.x - 60.0, 14.0, 46.0, 40.0), false])
	queue_redraw()

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_RESIZED:
		layout()

func _gui_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	if e is InputEventScreenTouch:
		var st: InputEventScreenTouch = e
		if st.pressed:
			_press(st.index, st.position)
		else:
			_release(st.index)
		accept_event()
	elif e is InputEventScreenDrag:
		var sd: InputEventScreenDrag = e
		_drag(sd.index, sd.position)
		accept_event()

func _press(id: int, p: Vector2) -> void:
	for b in buttons:
		if b[2].has_point(p):
			b[3] = true
			btn_ids[id] = b[0]
			if b[0] == "brake":
				brake_held = true
			else:
				emit_signal("pressed", b[0])
			pressed_vis[b[0]] = 0.25
			queue_redraw()
			return
	if thr_rect.grow(26.0).has_point(p):
		thr_id = id
		_set_throttle(p)
		return
	if rud_rect.grow(14.0).has_point(p):
		rud_id = id
		_set_rudder(p)
		return
	if p.distance_to(stick_c) < stick_r * 1.9:
		stick_id = id
		_set_stick(p)
		return
	# anywhere else on the left half = stick (big thumb area)
	if p.x < size.x * 0.45 and p.y > size.y * 0.35:
		stick_id = id
		stick_c = p
		_set_stick(p)

func _release(id: int) -> void:
	if btn_ids.has(id):
		var nm: String = btn_ids[id]
		for b in buttons:
			if b[0] == nm:
				b[3] = false
		if nm == "brake":
			brake_held = false
		btn_ids.erase(id)
	if id == stick_id:
		stick_id = -1
		stick = Vector2.ZERO
		layout()
	if id == rud_id:
		rud_id = -1
		rudder = 0.0
	if id == thr_id:
		thr_id = -1
	queue_redraw()

func _drag(id: int, p: Vector2) -> void:
	if id == stick_id:
		_set_stick(p)
	elif id == rud_id:
		_set_rudder(p)
	elif id == thr_id:
		_set_throttle(p)

func _set_stick(p: Vector2) -> void:
	var d := (p - stick_c) / stick_r
	if d.length() > 1.0:
		d = d.normalized()
	stick = Vector2(d.x, d.y)   # pull down on screen = pull back = pitch up
	queue_redraw()

func _set_rudder(p: Vector2) -> void:
	rudder = clamp((p.x - rud_rect.get_center().x) / (rud_rect.size.x * 0.5 - 14.0), -1.0, 1.0)
	queue_redraw()

func _set_throttle(p: Vector2) -> void:
	throttle = clamp(1.0 - (p.y - thr_rect.position.y - 10.0) / (thr_rect.size.y - 20.0), 0.0, 1.0)
	queue_redraw()

func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	var changed := false
	for k in pressed_vis.keys():
		pressed_vis[k] -= dt
		if pressed_vis[k] <= 0.0:
			pressed_vis.erase(k)
		changed = true
	if changed:
		queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	var line := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
	var fill := Color(0.1, 0.12, 0.18, 0.45)
	# stick
	draw_circle(stick_c, stick_r, fill)
	draw_arc(stick_c, stick_r, 0.0, TAU, 48, line, 2.0)
	draw_line(stick_c + Vector2(-stick_r, 0), stick_c + Vector2(stick_r, 0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2), 1.0)
	draw_line(stick_c + Vector2(0, -stick_r), stick_c + Vector2(0, stick_r), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2), 1.0)
	draw_circle(stick_c + stick * stick_r * 0.8, stick_r * 0.32, Color(1, 0.85, 0.3, 0.85))
	draw_string(font, Vector2(stick_c.x - stick_r, stick_c.y + stick_r + 16.0), "STICK  ▼ pull up", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, stick_r * 2.0, 11, line)
	# rudder slider
	draw_rect(rud_rect, fill)
	draw_rect(rud_rect, line, false, 2.0)
	var rx := rud_rect.get_center().x + rudder * (rud_rect.size.x * 0.5 - 14.0)
	draw_circle(Vector2(rx, rud_rect.get_center().y), 14.0, Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 0.85))
	draw_string(font, Vector2(rud_rect.position.x, rud_rect.position.y - 4.0), "◀ RUDDER ▶", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rud_rect.size.x, 11, line)
	# throttle
	draw_rect(thr_rect, fill)
	draw_rect(thr_rect, line, false, 2.0)
	var y := thr_rect.position.y + 10.0 + (1.0 - throttle) * (thr_rect.size.y - 20.0)
	draw_rect(Rect2(thr_rect.position.x + 4.0, y, thr_rect.size.x - 8.0, thr_rect.end.y - 4.0 - y), Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.1, 0.6))
	draw_rect(Rect2(thr_rect.position.x - 6.0, y - 8.0, thr_rect.size.x + 12.0, 16.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
	draw_string(font, Vector2(thr_rect.position.x - 20.0, thr_rect.position.y - 6.0), "THROTTLE", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, thr_rect.size.x + 40.0, 11, line)
	draw_string(font, Vector2(thr_rect.position.x - 20.0, thr_rect.end.y + 16.0), "%d%%" % int(throttle * 100.0), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, thr_rect.size.x + 40.0, 12, Color(1, 1, 1))
	# buttons
	for b in buttons:
		var r: Rect2 = b[2]
		var held: bool = b[3] or pressed_vis.has(b[0])
		draw_rect(r, Color(1.0, 0.75, 0.2, 0.75) if held else fill)

class_name Aircraft
extends Node3D
## Flight model: lift/drag/thrust/gravity, body-rate control, wheels on terrain.

signal touchdown(vs: float, hard: bool)
signal crashed(reason: String)
signal event(name: String)

const G := 9.81
const RHO0 := 1.225

var spec: Dictionary
var world: World
var model: Node3D

# state
var vel := Vector3.ZERO           # world m/s
var omega := Vector3.ZERO         # body rates rad/s: x pitch (+ nose up), y yaw (+ nose right), z roll (+ right wing down)
var throttle := 0.0               # 0..1
var ab := false
var flap_idx := 0
var flap_pos := 0.0               # degrees, animated
var gear_target := 1.0            # 1 = down
var gear_pos := 1.0
var brake := 0.0                  # 0..1 wheel brakes
var park := true
var airbrake := false
var airbrake_pos := 0.0
var reverse := false
var trim := 0.0
var in_pitch := 0.0
var in_roll := 0.0
var in_yaw := 0.0
var helper := true
var rpm := 0.0                    # prop rpm or jet N1 (0..100)
var alive := true
var fuel := 1.0

# derived (read by HUD)
var airspeed := 0.0
var alpha := 0.0
var beta := 0.0
var gforce := 1.0
var vs := 0.0
var on_ground := true
var wheels_down := 0
var stall := false
var stall_amount := 0.0
var overspeed := false
var ground_speed := 0.0
var touch_vs := 0.0
var air_time := 0.0
var ground_time := 0.0
var prev_vel := Vector3.ZERO
var prop_angle := 0.0
var engine_sound_level := 0.0
var max_g := 1.0
var min_g := 1.0
var total_roll := 0.0
var total_pitch := 0.0
var prev_roll := 0.0
var landed_here := false
var wing_hit := false
var surface_now := 0
var skid := 0.0
var dist_flown := 0.0

func setup(s: Dictionary, w: World, paint: Color) -> void:
	spec = s
	world = w
	if model:
		model.queue_free()
	model = Planes.build(s.id, paint)
	add_child(model)
	gear_target = 1.0
	gear_pos = 1.0

func flap_deg() -> float:
	return spec.flaps[flap_idx]

func set_flaps(i: int) -> void:
	i = clampi(i, 0, spec.flaps.size() - 1)
	if i != flap_idx:
		flap_idx = i
		emit_signal("event", "flaps")

func toggle_gear() -> void:
	if not spec.retract:
		return
	if on_ground and gear_target > 0.5:
		emit_signal("event", "gear_blocked")
		return
	gear_target = 0.0 if gear_target > 0.5 else 1.0
	emit_signal("event", "gear")

func gear_down() -> bool:
	return gear_pos > 0.95

func place(pos: Vector3, heading_deg: float, speed: float = 0.0) -> void:
	global_position = pos
	rotation = Vector3(0, -deg_to_rad(heading_deg), 0)
	vel = -global_transform.basis.z * speed
	omega = Vector3.ZERO
	alive = true
	throttle = 0.0 if speed < 1.0 else 0.6
	park = speed < 1.0
	brake = 0.0
	trim = 0.0
	flap_idx = 0
	gear_target = 1.0 if speed < 1.0 else 0.0
	gear_pos = gear_target
	airbrake = false
	airbrake_pos = 0.0
	reverse = false
	ab = false
	fuel = 1.0
	max_g = 1.0
	min_g = 1.0
	prev_vel = vel
	air_time = 0.0
	ground_time = 0.0
	wing_hit = false
	dist_flown = 0.0
	on_ground = speed < 1.0

func heading_deg() -> float:
	var f := -global_transform.basis.z
	var h := rad_to_deg(atan2(f.x, -f.z))
	if h < 0.0:
		h += 360.0
	return h

func pitch_deg() -> float:
	var f := -global_transform.basis.z
	return rad_to_deg(asin(clamp(f.y, -1.0, 1.0)))

func bank_deg() -> float:
	var r := global_transform.basis.x
	var u := global_transform.basis.y
	return rad_to_deg(atan2(-r.y, u.y)) if u.y > -0.999 else 0.0

func altitude_ft() -> float:
	return global_position.y / Planes.FT

func agl_m() -> float:
	return global_position.y - world.height(global_position.x, global_position.z) - gear_h()

func gear_h() -> float:
	return -spec.gear.l.y

func rho() -> float:
	return RHO0 * exp(-max(global_position.y, 0.0) / 8500.0)

func thrust_force() -> float:
	var r := rho() / RHO0
	var t := 0.0
	if spec.kind == "prop":
		t = spec.Tmax * throttle * clamp(1.0 - 0.55 * airspeed / spec.Vmax, 0.2, 1.0) * pow(r, 0.8)
	else:
		var tmax: float = spec.get("abT", spec.Tmax) if ab else spec.Tmax
		t = tmax * (0.03 + 0.97 * throttle) * pow(r, 0.75) * (1.0 + 0.25 * clamp(airspeed / 340.0, 0.0, 1.5))
		if reverse and spec.reverse:
			t = -spec.Tmax * throttle * 0.6 * pow(r, 0.75)
	return t

func step(dt: float) -> void:
	if not alive:
		return
	var xf := global_transform
	var bs := xf.basis
	var fwd := -bs.z
	var up := bs.y
	var right := bs.x
	# --- animated systems ---
	var fl_target: float = spec.flaps[flap_idx]
	flap_pos = move_toward(flap_pos, fl_target, dt * 6.0)
	gear_pos = move_toward(gear_pos, gear_target, dt * 0.35)
	airbrake_pos = move_toward(airbrake_pos, 1.0 if airbrake else 0.0, dt * 1.5)
	var target_rpm := 0.0
	if spec.kind == "prop":
		target_rpm = spec.idle_rpm + (spec.max_rpm - spec.idle_rpm) * throttle
	else:
		target_rpm = 22.0 + 78.0 * throttle + (6.0 if ab else 0.0)
	rpm = lerp(rpm, target_rpm, min(1.0, dt * (3.0 if spec.kind == "prop" else 1.1)))
	if spec.kind == "jet":
		var burn := throttle * 0.0009 + (0.004 if ab else 0.0)
		fuel = max(0.0, fuel - burn * dt)
	else:
		fuel = max(0.0, fuel - throttle * 0.00025 * dt)
	# --- air data ---
	var vb := bs.inverse() * vel
	var vf := -vb.z
	airspeed = vel.length()
	alpha = atan2(-vb.y, max(vf, 0.5)) if airspeed > 1.0 else 0.0
	beta = atan2(vb.x, max(abs(vf), 0.5)) if airspeed > 1.0 else 0.0
	var q := 0.5 * rho() * airspeed * airspeed
	var S: float = spec.S
	# lift coefficient with flaps and stall
	var cl_flap: float = flap_pos * spec.flapCL
	var cl_lin: float = spec.CL0 + spec.CLa * alpha + cl_flap
	var cl_max: float = spec.CLmax + cl_flap
	var a_stall: float = (cl_max - spec.CL0 - cl_flap) / spec.CLa
	var cl := cl_lin
	stall_amount = 0.0
	if alpha > a_stall:
		var over := alpha - a_stall
		stall_amount = clamp(over / 0.2, 0.0, 1.0)
		cl = cl_max * (1.0 - 0.55 * stall_amount) + 0.3 * sin(2.0 * alpha) * stall_amount
	elif alpha < -a_stall * 0.8:
		var over2 := -alpha - a_stall * 0.8
		stall_amount = clamp(over2 / 0.2, 0.0, 1.0)
		cl = -cl_max * 0.7 * (1.0 - 0.5 * stall_amount)
	stall = stall_amount > 0.02 and airspeed > 8.0 and not on_ground
	var cd: float = spec.CD0 + cl * cl / (PI * spec.AR * spec.e) + flap_pos * spec.flapCD
	cd += gear_pos * spec.gearCD + airbrake_pos * spec.brakeCD + abs(beta) * 0.4 + stall_amount * 0.08
	# wave drag for jets near Mach 1
	var mach := airspeed / 340.0
	if mach > 0.85:
		cd += (mach - 0.85) * 0.35
	var lift := q * S * cl
	var drag := q * S * cd
	# lift direction: body up projected perpendicular to velocity
	var vdir := vel.normalized() if airspeed > 0.5 else fwd
	var ldir := (up - vdir * up.dot(vdir)).normalized() if airspeed > 0.5 else up
	var side := -q * S * 0.6 * beta
	var force := ldir * lift - vdir * drag + right * side + fwd * thrust_force()
	force += Vector3(0, -spec.mass * G, 0)
	var acc: Vector3 = force / spec.mass
	# --- control: target body rates ---
	var eff: float = clamp(airspeed / spec.Vref, 0.0, 1.25)
	var eff2 := eff * eff
	var pitch_in: float = clamp(in_pitch + trim, -1.0, 1.0)
	var roll_in := in_roll
	var yaw_in := in_yaw
	if helper and abs(in_yaw) < 0.05 and not on_ground:
		yaw_in = clamp(beta * 3.0 + roll_in * 0.08, -0.6, 0.6)
	var rates: Vector3 = spec.rates
	var stab: Vector3 = spec.stab
	var a_trim: float = spec.a_trim
	# the stick commands an angle of attack (full pull = past the stall), the nose follows
	var alpha_cmd: float = a_trim
	if pitch_in >= 0.0:
		alpha_cmd = a_trim + pitch_in * (a_stall * 1.15 - a_trim)
	else:
		alpha_cmd = a_trim + pitch_in * (a_stall * 0.9 + a_trim)
	# fly-by-wire style G limiter (the real F-16 and A320 have one)
	var gl: float = spec.get("glimit", 4.0)
	if q > 1.0:
		var cl_lim: float = gl * spec.mass * G / (q * S)
		var alpha_lim: float = (cl_lim - spec.CL0 - cl_flap) / spec.CLa
		if alpha_lim > a_trim:
			alpha_cmd = min(alpha_cmd, alpha_lim)
	var t_pitch: float = clamp((alpha_cmd - alpha) * stab.x * 3.0 * (0.4 + 0.6 * eff), -rates.x * eff, rates.x * eff)
	# at very low speed gravity still swings the nose down (tail slide / deep stall recovery)
	if not on_ground and airspeed < 15.0:
		t_pitch -= pitch_deg() / 90.0 * 0.5
	# post-stall: nose drops, wing rocks
	t_pitch -= stall_amount * 1.4 * eff2
	var t_roll: float = roll_in * rates.y * eff - beta * stab.z * eff2 * 0.5
	if stall_amount > 0.2 and not on_ground:
		t_roll += sin(air_time * 3.0) * stall_amount * 0.8
	if helper and abs(roll_in) < 0.05 and not on_ground:
		t_roll -= deg_to_rad(bank_deg()) * 0.25 * eff
	var t_yaw: float = yaw_in * rates.z * eff + beta * stab.y * eff2 * 2.2 - roll_in * 0.08 * eff
	var target := Vector3(t_pitch, t_yaw, t_roll)
	var tau := 0.18
	omega += (target - omega) * min(1.0, dt / tau) * (0.3 + 0.7 * eff)
	# --- wheels & ground ---
	var gear_d := gear_pos > 0.6
	var any_contact := false
	wheels_down = 0
	var contact_torque := Vector3.ZERO
	var contact_force := Vector3.ZERO
	var deepest := 0.0
	var pts: Array = []
	if gear_d:
		pts = [spec.gear.nose, spec.gear.l, spec.gear.r]
	var k: float = spec.mass * G / 0.12
	var c := 2.0 * sqrt(k * spec.mass) * 0.6
	var m: float = spec.mass
	var L: float = spec.len
	var I := Vector3(m * L * L / 12.0, m * (L * L + spec.span * spec.span) / 14.0, m * spec.span * spec.span / 16.0)
	var vb_now := bs.inverse() * vel
	surface_now = world.surface(global_position.x, global_position.z)
	for p in pts:
		var wp: Vector3 = xf * p
		var gh := world.height(wp.x, wp.z)
		var pen := gh - wp.y
		if pen > 0.0:
			any_contact = true
			wheels_down += 1
			deepest = max(deepest, pen)
			# velocity of this point (world)
			var r_body: Vector3 = p
			var vpt := vel + bs * (Vector3(0, 0, 0) + _cross_rates(r_body))
			var fy: float = k * pen - c * min(vpt.y, 0.0) * 0.5
			fy = max(fy, 0.0)
			var f := Vector3(0, fy, 0)
			# lateral grip and rolling resistance in body frame
			var vlocal := bs.inverse() * vpt
			var load := fy
			var side_f: float = -clamp(vlocal.x * 2.5, -1.0, 1.0) * load * 0.9
			var roll_f: float = -sign(vlocal.z) * load * 0.015
			# brakes on main wheels
			var bk := brake
			if park and airspeed < 2.0:
				bk = 1.0
			if p != spec.gear.nose or spec.gear.tail:
				roll_f += -clamp(vlocal.z * 4.0, -1.0, 1.0) * load * 0.45 * bk
			if surface_now == 1:
				roll_f += -sign(vlocal.z) * load * 0.05
			f += bs * Vector3(side_f, 0, roll_f)
			contact_force += f
			var fb := bs.inverse() * f
			contact_torque += r_body.cross(fb)
			skid = max(skid, abs(vlocal.x))
	# nose-wheel / tailwheel steering + rudder on the ground
	if any_contact:
		var gs := vb_now.z * -1.0
		var steer_rate: float = yaw_in * clamp(gs / 6.0, -1.0, 1.0) * 1.2 / (1.0 + abs(gs) * 0.045)
		if spec.gear.tail:
			steer_rate *= 1.3
		omega.y = lerp(omega.y, steer_rate + yaw_in * rates.z * eff * 0.5, min(1.0, dt * 6.0))
		# body hits ground? (nose tip, tail, wingtips, belly)
	# crash points
	var crash_pts := [
		Vector3(0, -0.3, -L * 0.5), Vector3(0, 0.0, L * 0.48),
		Vector3(-spec.span * 0.5, spec.eye.y - 1.0, 0.0), Vector3(spec.span * 0.5, spec.eye.y - 1.0, 0.0),
		Vector3(0, -gear_h() * 0.45, 0.0),
	]
	if spec.id == "trainer":
		crash_pts[2].y = 1.0
		crash_pts[3].y = 1.0
	var body_hit := false
	var body_reason := ""
	for i in range(crash_pts.size()):
		var cp: Vector3 = crash_pts[i]
		var wp2: Vector3 = xf * cp
		var gh2 := world.height(wp2.x, wp2.z)
		if gh2 > wp2.y:
			body_hit = true
			body_reason = ["Nose hit the ground", "Tail strike", "Wing hit the ground", "Wing hit the ground", "Belly landing - gear was up!"][i]
			if i == 1 and not spec.gear.tail and any_contact and airspeed < 40.0:
				body_hit = false
				body_reason = ""
			break
	# angular integration (aero rates + contact torques)
	omega += Vector3(contact_torque.x / I.x, -contact_torque.y / I.y, -contact_torque.z / I.z) * dt
	if any_contact:
		omega.x *= max(0.0, 1.0 - dt * 3.0)
		omega.z *= max(0.0, 1.0 - dt * 4.0)
	acc += contact_force / m
	# --- integrate ---
	prev_vel = vel
	vel += acc * dt
	global_position += vel * dt
	dist_flown += vel.length() * dt
	var db := bs.rotated(bs.x, omega.x * dt).rotated(bs.y, -omega.y * dt)
	db = db.rotated(db.z, -omega.z * dt)
	global_transform.basis = db.orthonormalized()
	if deepest > 0.5:
		global_position.y += deepest - 0.5
	# G force (load factor along body up)
	var a_tot := (vel - prev_vel) / dt + Vector3(0, G, 0)
	gforce = lerp(gforce, a_tot.dot(up) / G, min(1.0, dt * 8.0))
	if not on_ground:
		max_g = max(max_g, gforce)
		min_g = min(min_g, gforce)
	vs = vel.y
	ground_speed = Vector2(vel.x, vel.z).length()
	# roll/loop tracking for aerobatics
	var bank := bank_deg()
	var droll := wrapf(bank - prev_roll, -180.0, 180.0)
	prev_roll = bank
	total_roll += droll
	total_pitch += rad_to_deg(omega.x) * dt
	overspeed = airspeed > spec.Vne * Planes.KT
	# --- ground / air state transitions ---
	var was_ground := on_ground
	on_ground = any_contact
	if on_ground:
		ground_time += dt
		air_time = 0.0
	else:
		air_time += dt
		ground_time = 0.0
	if on_ground and not was_ground and air_time == 0.0:
		touch_vs = -prev_vel.y
		var hard := touch_vs > 3.0
		emit_signal("touchdown", touch_vs, hard)
		if touch_vs > 10.0:
			_crash("Too hard! %d ft/min down" % int(touch_vs / Planes.FT * 60.0))
			return
		if abs(bank) > 20.0:
			_crash("Wing hit the runway (bank %d°)" % int(abs(bank)))
			return
	if body_hit:
		_crash(body_reason)
		return
	if any_contact:
		if surface_now == 2:
			_crash("Splash! Landed in the water")
			return
		if surface_now == 3 and airspeed > 10.0:
			_crash("Hit rough mountain ground")
			return
		if surface_now == 1 and airspeed > 32.0:
			_crash("Too fast on the grass!")
			return
		if abs(bank) > 30.0 and airspeed > 5.0:
			_crash("Tipped over")
			return
	if overspeed and airspeed > spec.Vne * Planes.KT * 1.22:
		_crash("Overspeed! The wings came off")
		return
	if fuel <= 0.0:
		throttle = 0.0
	_animate(dt)

func _cross_rates(r: Vector3) -> Vector3:
	# velocity of a body point due to body rates (approx, small)
	var w := Vector3(omega.x, -omega.y, -omega.z)
	return w.cross(r)

func _crash(reason: String) -> void:
	alive = false
	vel = Vector3.ZERO
	omega = Vector3.ZERO
	emit_signal("crashed", reason)

func _animate(dt: float) -> void:
	if not model:
		return
	var pitch_in: float = clamp(in_pitch + trim, -1.0, 1.0)
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("Elev"), Vector3(-pitch_in * 22.0, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("Rudder"), Vector3(0, -in_yaw * 25.0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("AilL"), Vector3(-in_roll * 20.0, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("AilR"), Vector3(in_roll * 20.0, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("FlapL"), Vector3(flap_pos, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("FlapR"), Vector3(flap_pos, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("Airbrake"), Vector3(-airbrake_pos * 50.0, 0, 0))
	var sp := airbrake_pos
	if on_ground and (brake > 0.5 or park) and spec.id == "liner" and airspeed > 5.0:
		sp = 1.0
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("SpoilerL"), Vector3(-sp * 45.0, 0, 0))
	_rot(model.get_node_or_null("SpoilerR"), Vector3(-sp * 45.0, 0, 0))
	# gear retraction
	var gn: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("GearNose")
	var gl: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("GearL")
	var gr: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("GearR")
	if spec.retract:
		var a := (1.0 - gear_pos) * 95.0
		if gn:
			gn.rotation_degrees = Vector3(a, 0, 0)
			gn.visible = gear_pos > 0.02
		if gl:
			gl.rotation_degrees = Vector3(0, 0, -a)
			gl.visible = gear_pos > 0.02
		if gr:
			gr.rotation_degrees = Vector3(0, 0, a)
			gr.visible = gear_pos > 0.02
	# prop
	var prop: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("Prop")
	if prop:
		prop_angle += rpm / 60.0 * TAU * dt
		prop.rotation.z = prop_angle
		var disc: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("PropDisc")
		if disc:
			disc.visible = rpm > 900.0
	for nm in ["FanL", "FanR"]:
		var f: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null(nm)
		if f:
			f.rotation.y += rpm * 0.3 * dt
	var burner: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("Burner")
	if burner:
		burner.visible = ab and throttle > 0.9 and fuel > 0.0
		burner.scale = Vector3(1, 0.8 + 0.4 * randf(), 1)
	for nm in ["RevL", "RevR"]:
		var r: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null(nm)
		if r:
			r.visible = reverse
	var beacon: Node3D = model.get_node_or_null("Beacon")
	if beacon:
		beacon.visible = fmod(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0, 1.0) < 0.15

func _rot(n: Node3D, deg: Vector3) -> void:
	if n == null:
		return
	if deg.y != 0.0:
		n.rotation_degrees.y = deg.y
	else:
		n.rotation_degrees.x = deg.x
		n.rotation_degrees.z = deg.z

class_name Missions

## Mission definitions and runtime scoring.

	]

static func by_id(id: String) -> Dictionary:
	for m in list():
		if m.id == id:
			return m
	return list()[list().size() - 1]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime

var def: Dictionary
var plane: Aircraft
var world: World
var checklist: Array = []      # [text, done]
var gates: Array = []          # Vector3 centres
var gate_r := 60.0
var gate_i := 0
var timer := 0.0
var timing := false
var done := false
var failed := false
var result_text := ""
var stars := 0
var score_lines: Array = []
var issues := 0
var stall_warned := false
var overspeed_warned := false
var landed := false
var touch_vs := 0.0
var touch_off := 0.0
var touch_zone := false
var touch_pos := Vector3.ZERO
var land_target := "runway"   # runway / strip

var stunt_order := ["Aileron roll", "Loop", "Knife edge 3 s", "Inverted 5 s", "Steep turn 360°"]
var knife_t := 0.0
var inv_t := 0.0
var turn_acc := 0.0
var turn_bank_ok := true
var roll_start := 0.0
var pitch_start := 0.0

var wp_name := ""
var phase := 0
var max_alt := 0.0

var nav_dist := 0.0

func start(d: Dictionary, p: Aircraft, w: World) -> void:
	def = d
	plane = p
	world = w
	gates.clear()
	gate_i = 0
	timer = 0.0
	timing = false
	done = false
	failed = false
	stars = 0
	score_lines.clear()
	issues = 0
	stall_warned = false
	overspeed_warned = false
	landed = false
	phase = 0
	max_alt = 0.0
	started = false
	stunts.clear()
	knife_t = 0.0
	inv_t = 0.0
	turn_acc = 0.0
	land_target = "runway"
	nav_bearing = -1.0
	wp_name = ""
	checklist.clear()
	var s := plane.spec
	match d.id:
		"takeoff":
			_takeoff_checklist()
		"pattern":
			gates = [Vector3(100.0, A + 160.0, 0.0), Vector3(1000.0, A + 300.0, -700.0), Vector3(300.0, A + 320.0, -1500.0),

			gate_r = 90.0
		"landing":

		"mountain":
			waypoint = Vector3(World.STRIP_POS.x, World.STRIP_ALT + 150.0, World.STRIP_POS.y)
			wp_name = "MOUNTAIN STRIP"

		"rings":

				Vector3(1400.0, A + 90.0, 60.0), Vector3(2600.0, A + 140.0, 700.0), Vector3(3600.0, 110.0, 1800.0),
				Vector3(4300.0, 80.0, 3000.0), Vector3(4100.0, 70.0, 4200.0), Vector3(3000.0, 120.0, 4400.0),
				Vector3(1500.0, A + 150.0, 3500.0), Vector3(200.0, A + 200.0, 2200.0), Vector3(-1300.0, A + 260.0, 1000.0),
				Vector3(-2300.0, A + 230.0, -400.0), Vector3(-2100.0, A + 180.0, -1300.0), Vector3(-800.0, A + 150.0, -900.0),
			]
			gates = pts

		"aero":

	_refresh_checklist()

func _takeoff_checklist() -> void:
	var s := plane.spec
	checklist.clear()
	if s.flaps.size() > 1:
		checklist.append(["Set take-off flaps (%s)" % _to_flap_name(), false])
	checklist.append(["Release the parking brake", false])
	checklist.append(["Full throttle", false])
	checklist.append(["Rotate at Vr = %d kt (pull back gently)" % s.Vr, false])
	if s.retract:
		checklist.append(["Positive climb: gear up", false])
	if s.flaps.size() > 1:
		checklist.append(["Flaps up above %d kt" % int(s.Vr * 1.25), false])
	checklist.append(["Climb to 1000 ft above the airport", false])

func _to_flap_name() -> String:
	var s := plane.spec
	match s.id:
		"trainer": return "10"
		"viper": return "DOWN"
		"liner": return "2"
	return "UP"

func to_flap_idx() -> int:
	match plane.spec.id:
		"trainer": return 1
		"viper": return 1
		"liner": return 2
	return 0

func _refresh_checklist() -> void:
	pass

func runway_dir_for(id: String) -> int:
	return 1

## Called every physics tick while flying
func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	if done or failed:
		return
	var p := plane
	var alt_agl := p.global_position.y - A
	max_alt = max(max_alt, alt_agl)
	if p.stall and not p.on_ground:
		stall_warned = true
	if p.overspeed:
		overspeed_warned = true
	if timing:
		timer += dt
	match def.id:
		"takeoff":
			_tick_takeoff()
		"pattern":
			_tick_gates()
			if gate_i >= gates.size():
				nav_bearing = _bearing_to(Vector3(-1250.0, A, 0.0))
				nav_dist = _dist_to(Vector3(-1250.0, A, 0.0))
				wp_name = "RUNWAY 09"
		"landing":
			nav_bearing = _bearing_to(Vector3(-1000.0, A, 0.0))
			nav_dist = _dist_to(Vector3(-1000.0, A, 0.0))
			wp_name = "RUNWAY 09"
		"mountain":
			nav_bearing = _bearing_to(waypoint)
			nav_dist = Vector2(p.global_position.x - waypoint.x, p.global_position.z - waypoint.z).length()
			if not timing and not p.on_ground:
				timing = true
		"rings":
			_tick_gates()
			if gate_i >= gates.size() and not done:
				_finish_rings()
		"aero":
			_tick_aero(dt)
		"airline":
			_tick_airline()

func _bearing_to(v: Vector3) -> float:
	var d := v - plane.global_position
	var b := rad_to_deg(atan2(d.x, -d.z))
	if b < 0.0:
		b += 360.0
	return b

func _dist_to(v: Vector3) -> float:
	return Vector2(plane.global_position.x - v.x, plane.global_position.z - v.z).length()

func _tick_takeoff() -> void:
	var p := plane
	var s := p.spec
	var i := 0
	for item in checklist:
		var txt: String = item[0]
		if item[1]:
			i += 1
			continue
		var ok := false
		if txt.begins_with("Set take-off flaps"):
			ok = p.flap_idx == to_flap_idx()
		elif txt.begins_with("Release"):
			ok = not p.park
		elif txt.begins_with("Full throttle"):
			ok = p.throttle >= 0.95
		elif txt.begins_with("Rotate"):
			ok = not p.on_ground and p.air_time > 0.5
			if ok and p.airspeed < s.Vr * Planes.KT * 0.85:
				issues += 1
				score_lines.append("Rotated too slow (stall risk)")
		elif txt.begins_with("Positive climb"):
			ok = p.gear_pos < 0.5 and not p.on_ground
			if ok and p.vs < 0.0:
				issues += 1
		elif txt.begins_with("Flaps up"):
			ok = p.flap_idx == 0 and not p.on_ground
			if ok and p.airspeed < s.Vr * Planes.KT * 1.1:
				issues += 1
				score_lines.append("Flaps retracted too slow")
		elif txt.begins_with("Climb to"):
			ok = p.global_position.y - A >= 1000.0 * Planes.FT
		if ok:
			item[1] = true
		else:
			break
		i += 1
	if i >= checklist.size():
		var extra := 0
		if stall_warned:
			extra += 1
			score_lines.append("Stall warning sounded")
		if overspeed_warned:
			extra += 1
			score_lines.append("Overspeed")
		var total := issues + extra
		stars = 3 if total == 0 else (2 if total == 1 else 1)
		score_lines.push_front("Checklist complete!")
		result_text = "YOU'RE A PILOT!"
		done = true

func _tick_gates() -> void:
	if gate_i >= gates.size():
		return
	var g: Vector3 = gates[gate_i]
	var d := plane.global_position.distance_to(g)
	nav_bearing = _bearing_to(g)
	nav_dist = d
	wp_name = "GATE %d/%d" % [gate_i + 1, gates.size()]
	if d < gate_r:
		gate_i += 1
		if not timing:
			timing = true
		plane.emit_signal("event", "ring")

func _finish_rings() -> void:
	done = true
	timing = false
	result_text = "RACE DONE!"
	var t := timer
	score_lines.append("Time: %d:%02d.%d" % [int(t) / 60, int(t) % 60, int(fmod(t, 1.0) * 10.0)])
	var fast: float = 150.0
	var mid: float = 230.0
	if plane.spec.id == "liner":
		fast = 260.0
		mid = 360.0
	elif plane.spec.id == "viper":
		fast = 110.0
		mid = 160.0
	stars = 3 if t < fast else (2 if t < mid else 1)
	score_lines.append("Under %d s = 3 stars, under %d s = 2 stars" % [int(fast), int(mid)])

func _tick_aero(dt: float) -> void:
	var p := plane
	if p.on_ground:
		return
	var bank: float = abs(p.bank_deg())
	# roll: accumulate total roll while pitch stays shallow
	if not stunts["Aileron roll"]:
		if abs(p.total_roll - roll_start) >= 340.0:
			stunts["Aileron roll"] = true
			p.emit_signal("event", "stunt")
		if abs(p.pitch_deg()) > 50.0:
			roll_start = p.total_roll
	# loop: accumulate pitch rotation 340 deg
	if not stunts["Loop"]:
		if p.total_pitch - pitch_start >= 320.0:
			stunts["Loop"] = true
			p.emit_signal("event", "stunt")
		if p.omega.x < -0.2:
			pitch_start = p.total_pitch
	# knife edge: bank ~90 for 3 s
	if not stunts["Knife edge 3 s"]:
		if bank > 70.0 and bank < 110.0 and abs(p.pitch_deg()) < 35.0:
			knife_t += dt
			if knife_t >= 3.0:
				stunts["Knife edge 3 s"] = true
				p.emit_signal("event", "stunt")
		else:
			knife_t = 0.0
	if not stunts["Inverted 5 s"]:
		if bank > 150.0 and abs(p.pitch_deg()) < 35.0:
			inv_t += dt
			if inv_t >= 5.0:
				stunts["Inverted 5 s"] = true
				p.emit_signal("event", "stunt")
		else:
			inv_t = 0.0
	if not stunts["Steep turn 360°"]:
		if bank > 45.0 and bank < 80.0:
			turn_acc += abs(rad_to_deg(p.omega.y)) * dt + abs(rad_to_deg(p.omega.x)) * dt * sin(deg_to_rad(bank))
			if turn_acc >= 330.0:
				stunts["Steep turn 360°"] = true
				p.emit_signal("event", "stunt")
		else:
			turn_acc = max(0.0, turn_acc - dt * 60.0)
	checklist.clear()
	var n := 0
	for k in stunt_order:
		checklist.append([k, stunts[k]])
		if stunts[k]:
			n += 1
	if n == stunt_order.size():
		done = true
		result_text = "AIR SHOW STAR!"
		stars = 3
		score_lines.append("All 5 stunts done!")

func _tick_airline() -> void:
	var p := plane
	match phase:
		0:
			wp_name = "CLIMB"
			nav_bearing = -1.0
			checklist = [["Take off and climb to 8000 ft", false], ["Fly to the sea waypoint", false], ["Return and land on runway 27", false]]
			if p.global_position.y - A >= 8000.0 * Planes.FT:
				phase = 1
				timing = true
		1:
			checklist[0][1] = true
			nav_bearing = _bearing_to(waypoint)
			nav_dist = _dist_to(waypoint)
			wp_name = "SEA POINT"
			if nav_dist < 800.0:
				phase = 2
				p.emit_signal("event", "ring")
		2:
			checklist[1][1] = true
			var rw := Vector3(1250.0, A, 0.0)
			nav_bearing = _bearing_to(rw)
			nav_dist = _dist_to(rw)
			wp_name = "RUNWAY 27"

## Called by main on touchdown signal. Returns true when the mission is now finished.
func on_touchdown(vs: float) -> void:
	if landed or done or failed:
		return
	var p := plane
	if def.id in ["takeoff", "aero", "rings", "free"]:
		return
	if def.id == "pattern" and gate_i < gates.size():
		return
	if def.id == "airline" and phase < 2:
		return
	landed = true
	touch_vs = vs
	touch_pos = p.global_position
	if land_target == "strip":
		var l := world.strip_local(touch_pos.x, touch_pos.z)
		touch_off = abs(l.y)
		touch_zone = world.on_strip(touch_pos.x, touch_pos.z) and abs(l.x) < 350.0
	else:
		touch_off = abs(touch_pos.z)
		touch_zone = world.on_runway(touch_pos.x, touch_pos.z) and abs(touch_pos.x) < 1100.0

## Called each tick after landing to see if stopped
func check_stopped() -> void:
	if not landed or done or failed:
		return
	var p := plane
	if p.on_ground and p.airspeed < 1.5:
		_score_landing()

func _score_landing() -> void:
	var p := plane
	var fpm := touch_vs / Planes.FT * 60.0
	var pts := 100.0
	score_lines.append("Touchdown: %d ft/min" % int(fpm))
	if fpm > 600.0:
		pts -= 45
		score_lines.append("Very hard landing!")
	elif fpm > 300.0:
		pts -= 25
		score_lines.append("Firm landing")
	elif fpm < 120.0:
		score_lines.append("Butter smooth!")
	score_lines.append("Centreline: %d m off" % int(touch_off))
	if touch_off > 10.0:
		pts -= 25
	elif touch_off > 4.0:
		pts -= 10
	if not touch_zone:
		pts -= 30
		score_lines.append("Missed the touchdown zone")
	else:
		score_lines.append("In the touchdown zone")
	var on_surface := world.surface(p.global_position.x, p.global_position.z) == 0
	if not on_surface:
		pts -= 30
		score_lines.append("Stopped off the runway")
	else:
		score_lines.append("Stopped on the runway")
	if stall_warned:
		pts -= 10
		score_lines.append("Stall warning on approach")
	if def.id == "mountain":
		score_lines.push_front("Flight time %d:%02d" % [int(timer) / 60, int(timer) % 60])
	stars = 3 if pts >= 80 else (2 if pts >= 50 else 1)
	result_text = "LANDED!" if stars < 3 else "PERFECT LANDING!"
	done = true

func fail(reason: String) -> void:
	failed = true
	result_text = "CRASH"
	score_lines = [reason]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Synthesized sounds for Sky Captain -> assets/sfx/*.wav (16-bit mono 22050 Hz)."""
import math, random, struct, wave, os
SR = 22050
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "assets", "sfx")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
random.seed(7)

def save(name, samples, loop=False):
    m = max(1e-6, max(abs(s) for s in samples))
    data = b"".join(struct.pack("<h", int(max(-1, min(1, s / m)) * 32000 * 0.9)) for s in samples)
    with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".wav"), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(data)
    print(name, len(samples) / SR)

def lowpass(x, a):
    y = []; p = 0.0
    for s in x:
        p += a * (s - p); y.append(p)
    return y

def env(i, n, a, r):
    t = i / SR
    e = min(1, t / a) if a > 0 else 1
    rem = (n - i) / SR
    if rem < r: e *= rem / r
    return e

# --- piston engine loop (4-cylinder-ish buzz at base 60 Hz) ---
n = SR * 2
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    f = 55.0
    v = 0
    for k, a in ((1, 1.0), (2, 0.7), (3, 0.4), (4, 0.35), (6, 0.2), (8, 0.12)):
        v += a * math.sin(2 * math.pi * f * k * t)
    v += 0.35 * (random.random() * 2 - 1)
    s.append(v)
s = lowpass(s, 0.25)
save("piston", s, True)

# --- jet engine loop (whine + roar) ---
n = SR * 2
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = 0.5 * (random.random() * 2 - 1)
    v += 0.25 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 180 * t) + 0.15 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 2400 * t + 2 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 3 * t))
    s.append(v)
s = lowpass(s, 0.35)
save("jet", s, True)

# --- wind loop ---
n = SR * 2
s = [random.random() * 2 - 1 for _ in range(n)]
s = lowpass(lowpass(s, 0.06), 0.06)
save("wind", s, True)

# --- rolling / wheels on ground ---
n = SR
s = [random.random() * 2 - 1 for _ in range(n)]
s = lowpass(s, 0.12)
save("roll", s, True)

# --- stall horn ---
n = int(SR * 0.6)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = (1 if math.sin(2 * math.pi * 440 * t) > 0 else -1) * 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 880 * t)
    s.append(v * env(i, n, 0.01, 0.05) * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 7 * t)))
save("stall", s)

# --- gear warning / pull-up (two-tone) ---
n = int(SR * 0.8)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    f = 600 if (t % 0.4) < 0.2 else 450
    s.append(math.sin(2 * math.pi * f * t) * env(i, n, 0.01, 0.05))
save("warn", s)

# --- touchdown thud + chirp ---
n = int(SR * 0.5)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = math.sin(2 * math.pi * 70 * t) * math.exp(-t * 14) * 1.2
    v += (random.random() * 2 - 1) * math.exp(-t * 30) * 0.8
    v += math.sin(2 * math.pi * 1800 * t) * math.exp(-t * 25) * 0.4
    s.append(v)
save("touch", s)

# --- gear clunk ---
n = int(SR * 0.4)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = (random.random() * 2 - 1) * math.exp(-t * 20) * 0.6 + math.sin(2 * math.pi * 120 * t) * math.exp(-t * 10)
    if t > 0.25: v += math.sin(2 * math.pi * 90 * (t - 0.25)) * math.exp(-(t - 0.25) * 18)
    s.append(v)
save("gear", s)

# --- flaps servo ---
n = int(SR * 0.7)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = math.sin(2 * math.pi * (220 + 20 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 30 * t)) * t) * 0.5 + (random.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2
    s.append(v * env(i, n, 0.03, 0.1))
save("flaps", lowpass(s, 0.3))

# --- click / ding / fail / crash ---
n = int(SR * 0.08)
save("click", [math.sin(2 * math.pi * 1500 * i / SR) * env(i, n, 0.002, 0.04) for i in range(n)])
n = int(SR * 0.9)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = 0
    for k, f in enumerate((880, 1320, 1760)):
        st = k * 0.12
        if t > st: v += math.sin(2 * math.pi * f * (t - st)) * math.exp(-(t - st) * 5)
    s.append(v)
save("ding", s)
n = int(SR * 1.6)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = 0
    for k, f in enumerate((660, 880, 1100, 1320, 1760)):
        st = k * 0.1
        if t > st: v += math.sin(2 * math.pi * f * (t - st)) * math.exp(-(t - st) * 3)
    s.append(v)
save("win", s)
n = int(SR * 0.6)
s = [(math.sin(2 * math.pi * 300 * i / SR) + math.sin(2 * math.pi * 230 * i / SR)) * env(i, n, 0.01, 0.3) for i in range(n)]
save("fail", s)
n = int(SR * 1.5)
s = []
for i in range(n):
    t = i / SR
    v = (random.random() * 2 - 1) * math.exp(-t * 3) + math.sin(2 * math.pi * 45 * t) * math.exp(-t * 4) * 1.5
    s.append(v)
save("crash", lowpass(s, 0.3))
# --- ring pass whoosh ---
n = int(SR * 0.35)
s = [random.random() * 2 - 1 for _ in range(n)]
s = lowpass(s, 0.4)
save("ring", [s[i] * env(i, n, 0.08, 0.2) * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 600 * i / SR)) for i in range(n)])
# --- camera shutter ---
n = int(SR * 0.15)
save("shutter", [(random.random() * 2 - 1) * (math.exp(-i / SR * 60) + (math.exp(-(i / SR - 0.07) * 60) if i / SR > 0.07 else 0)) for i in range(n)])

import os, re
w = open('index.wasm','rb').read()
LIM = 15 * 1024 * 1024 - 4096
parts = [w[i:i+LIM] for i in range(0, len(w), LIM)]
assert len(parts) <= 3, len(parts)
for i, p in enumerate(parts):
    open('index.part%d.wasm' % (i+1), 'wb').write(p)
os.remove('index.wasm')

h = h.replace('<head>', '').replace('</head>', '').replace('<body>', '').replace('</body>', '')

print('parts', len(parts), [len(p) for p in parts])
